page_title: RMA 0-0 BET | Real Madrid v Betis 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

90+2' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) inside the box.
89' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) coming on for Toni Kroos.
85' The corner kick is deflected to Federico Valverde (Real Madrid), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
85' The corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
85' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Francisco Vieites dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the left side of the goal.
84' Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
83' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Francisco Vieites comes off his line to gather the ball.

82' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Kepa Arrizabalaga allowed him to make a comfortable save.
81' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) replaces Willian Jose.
77' Real Madrid are ruled offside.
76' The attendance is 73614.
75' A pass from Rodrygo gives Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
74' It is time for a substitution. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is on for Daniel Carvajal.
74' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga will be replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

73' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
72' It will be a substitution. Sergi Altimira (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Rodri walks off.
72' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
70' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) attacks the corner from Toni Kroos in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
69' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
69' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
67' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
65' Willian Jose (Betis) has a goal ruled out for offside!
64' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eder Militao (Real Madrid) replacing Nacho Fernandez.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thibaut Courtois trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kepa Arrizabalaga (Real Madrid).
63' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is caught offside once again.
62' Rodri (Betis) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ayoze Perez. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
61' Rodri (Betis) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

60' Thibaut Courtois was forced into action to thwart Juan Miranda (Betis). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
59' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

59' So close! Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.

58' Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Real Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

56' A long pass finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Francisco Vieites reacts well to make a good save.
54' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
53' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
52' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

51' Ayoze Perez (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Thibaut Courtois pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
50' Rodri (Betis) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ayoze Perez.
48' The resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Betis) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' Rodri (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
46' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails painfully wide of the right post!
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Half-chance! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Francisco Vieites reacts well to snuff out the attack.
43' Celebrations are cut short for Betis as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
40' The Betis players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
39' Juan Miranda fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Johnny Cardoso (Betis) inside the box. He unleashes a quick shot into the top of the net. The score is 0:1.
38' Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). Betis are awarded a free kick.
37' Youssouf Sabaly swings the cross over. Hector Bellerin (Betis) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
35' Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.

34' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
31' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find Jude Bellingham, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
27' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
26' Marc Roca (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

25' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
22' The shot by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Francisco Vieites.
21' A snap shot by Rodri (Betis) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
17' Marc Roca (Betis) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play.
17' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Isidro Diaz de Mera signals a set piece. Betis win a free kick.
16' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

15' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
14' What a chance that is! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
13' Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
9' Vinicius Junior whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid), whose wild shot goes way over the crossbar.
5' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
5' Rodri (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Thibaut Courtois, who smothers the ball.
4' Marc Roca (Betis) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Hector Bellerin (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
3' A pass by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Betis will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Isidro Diaz de Mera.
